summary: Zombies Chronicles version of Shangri-La, covering power, pressure-plate Pack-a-Punch, the 31-79 JGb215, the main easter egg, side quests, and achievements.

files.summary: Overview of Shangri-La, its quest, traps, special zombies, and 31-79 JGb215 wonder weapon.
How to turn on both power switches and coordinate the four pressure plates to access Pack-a-Punch.
Complete four-player Time Travel Will Tell quest, including eclipse mode, matching symbols, waterslide, gas, spikes, tiles, dynamite, and focusing stone.
Locations of the three meteorite fragments used to activate Pareidolia.
How to activate and complete the timed Samantha doll hide-and-seek quest.
Requirements and practical steps for Shangri-La achievements.
